authority: Commercial Appellate Division of High Court

steps.title: Filing of Complaint / Suit
steps.description: Consumer complaint or commercial suit is filed before the appropriate forum or court having pecuniary and territorial jurisdiction.

steps.title: Scrutiny and Registration
steps.description: Complaint or suit is scrutinized and registered if it complies with statutory and procedural requirements.

steps.title: Issuance of Notice / Summons
steps.description: Notice or summons is issued to the opposite party to file a response or written statement.

steps.title: Filing of Reply / Written Statement
steps.description: Opposite party files its reply or written statement responding to the allegations.

steps.title: Evidence and Hearing
steps.description: Parties submit evidence and are heard on merits of the dispute.

steps.title: Arguments
steps.description: Final arguments are presented by both parties.

steps.title: Order / Judgment
steps.description: Forum or court passes an order or judgment granting or denying relief.

steps.title: Execution
steps.description: Order or decree may be executed in accordance with applicable law if not complied with voluntarily.
